name: gdpr
description: GDPR data portability (Art. 20) and right-to-erasure (Art. 17) tools for self-hosted nSelf instances.
author: nself

actions.export: Export all data for a user (Art. 20 portability)
actions.delete: Delete or anonymize all data for a user (Art. 17 erasure)
actions.status: Show the status of a GDPR request

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port and no HTTP server, but it reads/writes np_gdpr_requests directly via DATABASE_URL. `nself plugin install gdpr` must place the built nself-gdpr binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-gdpr, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself gdpr <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/gdpr*.go and cli/internal/gdpr/ under CLI-R11. internal/database.SanitizeIdentifier (one function) was copied verbatim into this plugin's own internal/database package since the CLI's internal/database is unreachable across the module boundary.
